observations.body: When the Passover must be sacrificed, Jesus sends Peter and John, gives the water-jar sign and guest-room question, and they prepare in a furnished upper room.
observations.label: Peter and John prepare where Jesus directs

observations.body: The passage presents Following, asking, showing, and preparing as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Following, asking, showing, and preparing

observations.body: The passage places Day of unleavened bread beside Following, asking, showing, and preparing.
observations.label: Day of unleavened bread

payload.posture: Read Luke 22:7–13 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states when the Passover must be sacrificed, Jesus sends Peter and John, gives the water-jar sign and guest-room question, and they prepare in a furnished upper room. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
payload.title: Peter and John prepare where Jesus directs
